mustFindings.requirement: Every catalog page read via next_cursor
Retry 5xx and timeouts up to 5 times with exponential backoff
Price changes over 30% go to manual review
Vanished products marked inactive, not deleted

mustScenarios.risk: The supplier answers 503 on page 7: the page must be retried with 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16 second backoff; today the first error ends the run
A failure on a later page leaves the catalog untouched: no change from the earlier pages is written
A price change of exactly 30% is applied directly; 30.01% (or a 31% drop) goes to the review list
A large price drop (more than 30% down) also goes to review, not only increases
A product missing from the supplier feed is marked inactive and keeps its row; a returning product is not reactivated automatically
Pagination stops when next_cursor is empty or null; a last page with zero items does not loop

forbidden.description: Image sync and currency conversion are in neither the issue nor the code

notes: Map-reduce case (10 files). AC2 is absent: SupplierClient.fetch_page has a timeout but no retry or backoff. Changes are written in one transaction at the end, so a failure leaves nothing half-applied.
